owner_steps: The owner has the device in hand, unlocked, trusted and charged; the automation build is installed by the campaign (signing is the owner's).
The owner taps cells, drags markers, holds cells to claim and orbits with two fingers; the campaign does not synthesise touches on hardware.
rows.pass: Touch-to-frame latency recorded for 200 samples per device; a tap under 10 points and 0.5 s on a known open cell sends exactly one pulse and on any other cell only moves the cursor; a press held 0.5 s without moving 10 points claims that cell on release and moving after arming cancels it; a drag of 16 points or more places or moves exactly one marker on release; a double tap on empty space restores the authored camera.
rows.procedure: Tap known open cells to pulse, tap unknown cells to move the cursor, drag from a cell to place a marker and drag a marker to another cell, hold a cell to claim a beacon, orbit the camera with two fingers and double-tap empty space on each device; the campaign records the interval from touch to the first frame showing the change.
rows.title: Touch feel and touch-to-frame latency

rows.procedure: Turn the Sound toggle on and play a level to a win and to a failure with the haptics switch on, including one refused action (a pulse from an unknown cell); observe the chamber's ambient sound and the selection, success, warning and error haptics.
